stops.date_confidence: attested (sorenkierkegaard.org). Correction to the pool, which folded two examinations into one entry: sorenkierkegaard.org separates them, first examination 25 April 1831 magna cum laude in languages and history, second examination 27 October 1831 summa cum laude in philosophy. Both are given here; the pool's single line calling the October exam one in classics, mathematics and philosophy is wrong.

attested (sorenkierkegaard.org). The absence of the mother from the journals is a documented feature of the surviving papers and is stated here as such, not as an inference about what she meant to him.

[R] as to date and content. sorenkierkegaard.org puts the great earthquake in 1835 and states the content directly, the discovery of the father's curse on God; the journal entry itself carries no date, and scholars have redated the episode as late as 1838 and disagree over how literally to read it. What is contested is the dating and the reading, not that the entry exists. The pool's claim that the content was never specified overstates the mystery. Day and month defaulted to order the segment. The quoted entry is given at sorenkierkegaard.org as II A 805 with no translator named; cross-check against SKS or the Hong Journals before quoting further.
